mechanism: Methimazole can cause agranulocytosis and immunosuppression, which may be exacerbated by amphetamine-induced sympathomimetic effects and potential immune modulation; additionally, stimulants may mask symptoms of thyroid dysfunction or agranulocytosis.
action: Monitor blood counts regularly in patients requiring concurrent therapy; ensure thyroid function is optimized before initiating lisdexamfetamine; counsel patients to report signs of infection or unusual bleeding immediately.
